summary: Verified Wayly SEO/AEO web build (/app/frontend). All 9 feature groups PASS: Templates index (20 cards, 6 cluster chips, search 'refund'=1, Complaints cluster=3, empty state + clear) works; all 20 template detail pages render with no console errors, Title Case H1s, FAQ, and 'last checked' footer; Care Plan Review retitled to 'Care Plan Review Question Checklist' with zero '12 questions'/'12 most important'/'twelve questions' occurrences; Articles index shows 45 articles with working search/sort/category and both new articles present; complaints and AT-HM articles render fully (FAQ accordion, internal links, HTML tier table); CHSP /chsp/extension-2029 renders corrected content (2029, 30 June, standalone/not merging) and /chsp/transition-2027 client-side redirects to /chsp/extension-2029; /api/program-reference/public returns the expected 01/10/2026 classifications (C1 11031.56, C3 22580.93, C8 80294.00) and 20/09/2026 lifetime caps (standard 140652.80, no_worse_off 88934.57); Organization JSON-LD on the homepage includes @type Organization, legalName 'Wayly Pty Ltd', slogan, and areaServed. Zero console errors across all tested pages. One observation (not a bug) flagged for main-agent/user confirmation re: the 4 non-letter templates not exposing Copy/DOCX.
action_items: OBSERVATION (not a defect — needs product confirmation): 4 of the 20 template detail pages do not render template-copy-btn / template-docx-btn because they use ChecklistBlock/QuestionsBlock/ProseBlock instead of LetterBlock. The brief says each template should show 'Copy text button... and Download (DOCX) button'. If the intent is letters-only, current implementation is correct and the brief wording is loose. Affected slugs: care-plan-review-questions, registered-supporter-checklist, aged-care-family-meeting-agenda, advance-care-planning-conversation-guide. If product wants Copy/DOCX everywhere, extend buttons to ChecklistBlock/QuestionsBlock/ProseBlock in /app/frontend/src/pages/resources/TemplateDetail.jsx.
critical_code_review_comments: TemplateDetail.jsx cleanly separates LetterBlock/ChecklistBlock/QuestionsBlock/ProseBlock — good composition, each has a distinct data-testid (template-letter / template-checklist / template-questions / template-prose).

CHSP redirect from /chsp/transition-2027 → /chsp/extension-2029 is implemented client-side (React Router navigate) — functional for SPA users but returns 200 (not a true 301) at the HTTP level. For strict SEO, a server-side 301 at the ingress/CDN layer would be preferred; verify production CDN config honours this if the brief requires an HTTP 301 for crawlers.

Articles index exposes data-testid^='articles-card-<slug>' but a given article slug appears on multiple cards in some layouts (featured + grid + related), so testID matching by prefix yields more DOM nodes than the count_text. Non-breaking, but worth noting for future test authors — rely on articles-result-count for truth.
Organization JSON-LD now exposes legalName / slogan / areaServed on home page — confirmed via raw HTML. Good.
test_credentials: N/A — all tested surfaces are public marketing/SEO pages, no auth required.
